payload.query: My knitted jumper is covered in little fuzzy balls. What can I do?

args.text: The little fuzzy balls on your knitted jumper are called pilling, which occurs where the fabric rubs against things like bag straps or under the arms [fabric-care#2]. To remove them, you can use a sweater comb or a fabric shaver, making sure to work gently on a flat surface [fabric-care#2]. To help prevent new pilling, wash your knitwear inside out on a gentle cycle [fabric-care#2]. Note that pilling is normal for wool and does not indicate that the garment is damaged [fabric-care#2].
